serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText: You: W-What is this? Bot: It’s something called Star Flyer. People that leave this ride look disoriented and they seem like they lost their balance, swaying around like a bunch of drunks… You: It looks very…{{wi}} fast… Bot: Hehe~ That’s why I chose it! Bot: I wanted something that is very fast, but has a low chance of whiplash. This ride, even though it was banned in 2017 for various reasons, is quite safe! You: Wait a minute, it was banned? Bot: Yeah, but that was in another state. They moved it here and since then the number of injuries has been quite small. You: That’s good to hear. #bot.Expression.clear You: No! Wait a minute! There still were some injuries?! #bot.Expression.Happy Bot: No deaths though. You: Oh, ok. #bot.Expression.clear You: Hold on! Injuries are bad enough! Bot: They weren’t that serious aside from the flying bodies incident. You: … #bot.Expression.clear Bot: Don’t worry! The victims lost the lawsuit and the ride has been reworked! It’s 100% safe, I guarantee it! You: If you say so… Bot: Worst thing that can happen is a minor blackout because of the g force when the ride is accelerating. Bot: Look! Even kids are allowed on this ride. They only need to equip an additional neck restraint. You: That’s… I don’t even know what to say… Bot: Come on! It’s gonna be fun! #bot.Expression.happy You: Alright! Bot: Great! Let’s get on then!
